title: Enforce author compiler authority boundary
summary: Enforced a versioned LLM author/compiler boundary: operations now carry registered role bindings, explicit semantic lineage, registry-compatible ownership, and explanation depth while salience and epistemic status remain authored; compiler output preserves those fields; V1 migration supplies faithful defaults; legacy V2 inputs receive an explicit compatibility diagnostic; raw primitives, keyframes, paths, coordinates, transforms, easing, opacity, timing, and DOM/SVG/HTML authority are rejected. Browser algebra smoke, 1312 tests, and the 243.99 KB entry build pass.
